name: Retune Resistance
body:
You become resistant to a different energy type, or possibly more resistant to the same energy type.

Prerequisite: Xax, Character Level 7.

Benefit: Reroll for your Chaotic Resistance racial trait and replace the old energy type with the new. In addition, increase the resist value provided by your Chaotic Resistance by 5.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
